servinfo.title: ABS Warning Light Does Not Come ON after Setting Ignition “ON”

servinfosub.title: System Description
servinfosub.ptxt: Operation (ON/OFF) of ABS warning light is controlled by ESP® control module through light driver module in combination meter.

If ESP® system is in good condition, ESP® control module turns ON ABS warning light with ignition “ON”, keeps the light ON for 2 seconds and then turns it OFF. If ABS control is deactivated by ESP® system failure, ABS warning light is turned ON continuously by ESP® control module. Also, the light is turned ON continuously by light driver module when the connector of ESP® control module is disconnected.

testgroup.title: Warning light check
testgroup.question: Do other indicator lights light up within 2 seconds after setting ignition “ON”?

test1.ptxt: Check DTC related to CAN communication.

action.ptxt: Go to troubleshooting for applicable DTC.
Replace combination meter and recheck warning light operation. If ABS warning light does not come ON, replace ESP® hydraulic unit / control module assembly and recheck warning light operation.

item.ptxt: ESP® hydraulic unit / control module assembly:

action.ptxt: Replace “MTR” fuse and check for short circuit to ground.

test1.ptxt: Check CAN communication circuit between ESP® control module and combination meter referring to “Troubleshooting for Communication Bus Off” in Section 10H.

action.ptxt: Repair or replace defective wire harness.

testgroup.title: Combination meter power supply and ground circuit check

test1.ptxt: Check combination meter power supply and ground circuits.

testgroup.question: Is check result OK?

action.ptxt: Replace combination meter and recheck warning light operation. If ABS warning light does not come ON, replace ESP® hydraulic unit / control module assembly and recheck warning light operation.

item.ptxt: ESP® hydraulic unit / control module assembly:

action.ptxt: Repair or replace defective wire harness.
